result:
None of the three solutions is correct.

The zero-error (Las Vegas) condition requires every irreducible representation of $B_N$ to appear in the span of the query representations $\bigoplus_{s\le t} V^{\otimes s}$, where $V$ is the natural representation. Working through the orbit decomposition of $[N]^t$ under $B_N$, an irrep $(\lambda,\mu)$ first appears at

$$t_{\min}(\lambda,\mu) = 2(|\lambda|-\lambda_1) + |\mu|.$$

Maximizing over bipartitions of $N$ gives $Q_{LV}(B_N) = 2N-2$, attained by $(\lambda,\mu)=((1^N),\varnothing)$.

I checked this directly for $N=3$, where the sign representation $\mathrm{sgn}(\sigma)$ (trivial on the signs) has multiplicity $0$ in $V^{\otimes t}$ for $t\le 3$ and multiplicity $3$ at $t=4$. So $Q_{LV}(B_3)\ge 4$, which rules out the answer $3$ from Solutions 2 and 3.

Solution 1 gives $3N/2-1$, which is $3.5$ at $N=3$ and is not an integer, so it cannot be a query count. It agrees with $2N-2$ only at $N=2$, where all three proposals happen to give $2$.

CHOICE: NONE
